transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Mostly sleep, I guess. I finally called the employee assistance program because I haven’t been sleeping right. I lie there replaying work stuff, things at home… then I wake up around 3 or 4 and feel like I never really rested.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… I guess so. Most days it’s like this heavy, gray feeling just kind of sticks with me, from work to the drive home and then at the house. Even when nothing’s really happening, I just feel… hollow.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. I mean… I used to look forward to stuff like pickup basketball, bowling nights, music festivals, having people over and using the smoker. Lately I mostly cancel, or if I do go, I’m just kind of there. Going through the motions, I guess.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I… yeah, sometimes. I’m not, like, planning to do anything to myself. But I do catch myself thinking… maybe people would be better off if I just didn’t wake up one morning.
How long have you been feeling this down most days?
Um… I guess it’s been about a year now. Maybe a little over—like a year and a couple months. Since things at home started getting worse, the arguments and all that.
During the past two weeks, have you felt down or empty like that nearly every day?
Yeah… pretty much most days. It’s like this heavy gray feeling follows me around—work, the car, home. Even when nothing’s really happening, I just feel kind of… hollow.
Have you noticed your appetite has gone down lately?
Yeah… I guess so. I don’t really feel hungry much. I’ll just have coffee and skip lunch, then kind of pick at dinner. Been that way for a while. My belt’s actually tighter now, so… I don’t know.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

Yeah… somewhat. I mean, I’m still getting to work, still doing the basics. But things slip—forecasts, client prep—and my team’s had to pick up some of that. At home I’m… not as present with my wife and kids as I used to be.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually up or irritable and had much more energy than usual?
Not really… I mean, I get irritated sometimes, sure, but I wouldn’t say I’ve had some period where I was unusually up or had a lot more energy than normal.
Do you feel these symptoms started because of the problems at home?
Yeah… I think so. It kind of started when the arguing at home got a lot worse. That’s been… maybe a year and a couple months now.
Has anyone close to you died around the time this started?
No… not that I can think of. No one close to me died around then.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things?
I don’t know… not really about a lot of different things. I worry some, but I wouldn’t say it’s excessive.
Compared with what’s been going on at home, do your depression symptoms feel stronger than you’d expect from that situation?
I’m not sure. I mean… it feels tied to what’s happening at home, so I don’t really know what would be “expected.” It doesn’t feel totally separate from it.
When you’re away from home for a while, do you still feel down?
Yeah… it doesn’t really go away. Even if I’m at work or in the car, it’s kind of just there. Like a heavy, gray feeling, I guess.
Did the sleep problem start before you began feeling depressed?

No… I think the sleep got bad around the same time. Maybe a little after I started feeling down. It’s mostly lying there replaying work stuff or arguments at home, then waking up at 3 or 4 and not really getting back to sleep.
Would you say this has caused significant distress in your life?

Yeah… I think so. I’m still getting through the day and showing up, but I’m slipping more than I’d like. My team’s had to cover for me when I miss things with forecasts or client prep. And at home… I’m there, but not really as present with my wife and kids.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah… I have. At work especially. I’ll be looking at a sales forecast or a client deck, and I end up reading the same slide over and over. I second-guess the numbers, and then I still can’t figure out what I want to say.
If the problems at home were to improve, do you think your low mood would lift?

I don’t know… maybe a little, but I don’t think it’s just home. Most days it’s like this heavy gray feeling just sort of follows me around—from work to the car to the house. Even when nothing’s really happening, I still feel kind of hollow.
Have you been feeling tired or low on energy nearly every day?
I don’t know… I mean, I get tired like anyone, but I haven’t really been tracking it. I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed it clearly every day.
Have you been feeling worthless nearly every day?

Yeah… I guess so. I don’t really like saying “worthless,” but I keep going over things I’ve done—late nights at work, tailgates, stupid purchases—and it turns into this thought that my wife and kids got stuck with someone selfish who keeps letting them down.
